Under the federal funds availability rules, a credit union generally must make a deposited check's funds available for withdrawal no later than the second business day after the deposit for many types of checks. Those are the standard time limits, but there are exceptions. For example, the amount of check deposits over $6,725 on any one banking day can be held longer. A credit union can also extend the hold when it has reasonable cause to believe a check is uncollectible, and in some other situations such as emergencies or repeated overdrafts.
